mechanics.preconditions: An EQUIVALENCE RELATION over stored objects, supplied as input (rewrite rules whose soundness is assumed, or witnessed equivalences); congruence closure only then has something to close. Extraction additionally needs a cost model over representatives.
mechanics.mechanism: Store one e-class per equivalence class instead of one node per expression; maintain congruence (equivalent subterms imply equivalent superterms) incrementally; saturate by applying rewrites until no new classes appear; extract the best representative under a declared cost. The compression IS the soundness obligation: everything merged is asserted interchangeable for every downstream query.
mechanics.claimed_benefit: Compact representation of exponentially many equivalent forms; saturation becomes feasible where naive enumeration is not; phase-ordering problems dissolve because all rewrite orders coexist.
mechanics.cost: Congruence maintenance (egg's rebuilding amortizes it); e-graph growth can still explode without saturation limits. In the Orion analogue: computing the equivalence key per accumulated structure, plus the witness check.
failure_modes: PRIMARY (the transfer's live danger): merging on a SURFACE congruence that is not a semantic equivalence. Shape-isomorphic structures with different content are NOT interchangeable knowledge; merging them corrupts every downstream query. e-graphs never have this problem because their equivalence is generated by declared rewrites; a transfer that substitutes 'same shape' for 'proven equivalent' imports the compression without the soundness.
Unbounded growth when saturation has no stopping rule (the parent's own known issue).
Extraction cost model smuggling in a scalar ranking over things the framework holds incomparable.
mechanics.scope: Source scope: term rewriting over a fixed signature with sound rewrite rules. Orion's structure space stores knowledge structures, not terms, and has NO rewrite system - so the faithful import has no input on current substrates (PRECONDITION_BLOCKED), and only a witnessed-equivalence adaptation is even a candidate.
mechanics.rakl_analogue: src/rakl/structure_space.py StructureSpace.accumulate appends EVERY accumulated structure to self.structures unconditionally; growth is measured in newly-seen ROLES only. Verified consequence: saturation can read BOUNDED_SATURATED (role-growth flat) while storage grows linearly with every restatement - the exact duplication exposure this mechanic addresses.
mechanics.candidate_transfer_obligation: Three-arm contest frozen in research/programme_question_audit_v1/assimilation/CONGRUENCE_CONTEST_PROTOCOL_V1.json: A = shipped atomic accumulation; B1 = faithful-to-surface congruence (merge on unlabeled shape isomorphism - the tempting import); B2 = governed adaptation (merge ONLY under an explicit relabeling-bijection witness, the transport S3 analogue, with query translation through the witness - the e-graph find() analogue). FALSIFIERS: (a) B2 shows no storage/time advantage over A at preserved recall - transfer worthless; (b) B2 loses recall on any declared-preserved query class - adaptation unsound; (c) B1 shows zero false merges on the real substrate - the witness requirement was unnecessary and the adaptation is over-engineered.

mechanics.preconditions: A declared target representation class; a declared SET of query types; per-pair tractability results (which queries are polytime in which class).
mechanics.mechanism: Compile once, offline, into a target class chosen so that the DECLARED query set becomes polytime; accept succinctness loss as the price. The map's core lesson: tractability is always RELATIVE TO A DECLARED QUERY CLASS - no representation makes everything cheap, and choosing a representation IS choosing which questions become cheap.
mechanics.claimed_benefit: Turns 'compilation helps' from a slogan into a contract: representation R makes query class Q polytime, and says nothing about queries outside Q.
mechanics.cost: Compilation cost (possibly exponential); succinctness loss; queries outside the declared class remain hard and MUST NOT be advertised.
failure_modes: Advertising tractability without naming the query class (the slogan failure - exactly the current state of the amortization thesis in this repo).
Silent query-class drift: adding a new query type and assuming the old compilation still serves it.
mechanics.scope: Source scope: propositional knowledge bases. The MAP STRUCTURE (representation x query-class tractability contract) transfers; none of the specific language results do.
mechanics.rakl_analogue: The amortization thesis in docs/REASONING_LOCATION.md ('solving becomes traversal') currently names no query classes. The structure space serves at least: signature/JUMP retrieval, role-exact match, derivation reachability, min-cut naming, obstruction lookup. Which of these stay cheap under which compaction is EXACTLY the knowledge-compilation question - and the congruence contest measures a first instance (role-exact match is NOT congruence-invariant; signature retrieval is).
mechanics.candidate_transfer_obligation: Produce a DECLARED QUERY-CLASS TABLE for the structure space: per query class, whether it is preserved/cheap under (i) atomic storage, (ii) witnessed congruence compaction, with measured or proved status per cell and CANNOT_CHECK where unknown. The congruence contest's per-query-class recall endpoints are the first two measured cells. FALSIFIER: a query class declared preserved that measurably degrades under the declared representation kills the contract's instance.

source_verification.V1: Aamodt & Plaza 1994, AI Communications 7(1):39-59 - title page verified from primary PDF (fetched 2026-08-14).
source_verification.V2: The cycle, verbatim from p.8: '1. RETRIEVE the most similar case or cases 2. REUSE the information and knowledge in that case to solve the problem 3. REVISE the proposed solution 4. RETAIN the parts of this experience likely to be useful for future problem solving'; and 'During RETAIN, useful experience is retained for future reuse, and the case base is updated by a new learned case, or by modification of some existing cases.'
source_verification.V3: Failure retention is contemplated in the source (p.2: an engineer 'may get a reminding to a mistake he made during a previous blow-out, and use this to avoid repeating the error once again') - so failure memory at case granularity is PARENT territory, not our novelty.
source_verification.CC1: CANNOT_CHECK this pass: the case-base MAINTENANCE literature (competence-preserving deletion, case-base pollution - Smyth & Keane; Leake & Wilson) was not primary-verified; the failure-mode names below are THIS PROGRAMME'S compilation labels, not source verbatim.

mechanics.preconditions: A case base of solved episodes; a similarity-based retrieval; an adaptation step; a retention policy.
mechanics.mechanism: RETRIEVE-REUSE-REVISE-RETAIN: solve by recalling the most similar solved case, adapting it, testing/repairing the result, and folding the experience back into the case base. Thirty years of deployments documented WHERE this loop rots; compiled here as obstruction knowledge in three families: RETRIEVAL BIAS (surface similarity retrieves the wrong case - our SURFACE_FALSE_FRIEND), ADAPTATION DRIFT (reused solution silently exceeds the preserved correspondence - our TRANSFER_OVERREACH), RETENTION POLLUTION (ungoverned retention degrades the base - our raw-is-not-canonical admission problem).
mechanics.claimed_benefit: For the transfer: an externally documented failure taxonomy for a loop with the SAME SHAPE as Orion's episode/lesson loop, usable as planted-world designs and residual types without rediscovering each failure natively.
mechanics.cost: Mapping cost only; the taxonomy is knowledge, not machinery.
failure_modes: Treating the mapping as evidence: that CBR systems failed a certain way does not prove Orion's loop will; the mapping licenses TEST DESIGN, not conclusions.
Forcing the correspondence: Orion's retention is already gated (episode admission, lesson versioning); planted worlds must attack the gates as built, not a strawman ungoverned RETAIN.
mechanics.scope: Structural analogy between loops, explicitly witnessed: retrieval=fibre/episode retrieval, reuse=transfer under contract, revise=verification/refutation, retain=episode admission + lesson consolidation. Disanalogy preserved: CBR retention is typically similarity-gated only; Orion's is authority-gated.
mechanics.rakl_analogue: episode_store/episode_admission (retain), semantic_shortcut SEARCH routing (retrieve), transport contract (reuse), verification/refutation surfaces (revise); residual/obstruction types in the fiber workflow.
mechanics.candidate_transfer_obligation: Build the failure-taxonomy-to-residual-type mapping as a table (each CBR failure family -> the Orion gate that should catch it -> a planted-world design that would expose it if the gate is dead). FALSIFIER per row: a planted instance of the CBR failure that the named Orion gate fails to catch refutes that gate's coverage claim; a gate that CANNOT be made to fire on any planted instance is a dead gate (the Paper 3 lesson).

mechanics.preconditions: A large library of kernel-checked lemmas; an automated prover that degrades with irrelevant premises; hence a relevance-filtering step.
mechanics.mechanism: Amortize proof effort by libraries of once-proved lemmas; the binding constraint is RETRIEVAL, not storage: given thousands of true lemmas, selecting the few relevant ones is the hard problem (premise selection), attacked with heuristics and learned filters. Truth authority is carried by the kernel at admission; selection carries NO authority - a badly selected premise set wastes budget but cannot make a false proof.
mechanics.claimed_benefit: Decades of evidence that verified amortization works at scale for the TRUTH coordinate, plus a precise statement of its operating bottleneck (selection) - which is Orion's retrieval problem with a literature.
mechanics.cost: Library curation; selection models; prover budget wasted on misselection.
failure_modes: Selection quality bounds usefulness: a perfect library with poor retrieval amortizes nothing (direct warning for the structure space as it grows).

Trust boundary: within a session stored lemmas are trusted from the build; use-time re-verification is NOT standard practice - this is where Orion's certificate re-check at use time differs, and the difference has a cost that must be measured, not asserted.
mechanics.scope: Source scope: formal mathematics with a kernel. The single-coordinate case (truth) of Orion's multi-coordinate authority. The parent PROVES the pattern can work; it does not cover specification-alignment, novelty or verifier-trust coordinates.
mechanics.rakl_analogue: structure_space.match at required_authority (retrieval under authority); certificates.py use-time verification; the premise-selection analogue is unbuilt: Orion currently has no learned or heuristic relevance filter over the space.
mechanics.candidate_transfer_obligation: Frame Orion's retrieval as premise selection: when the space is large, measure solve-budget waste attributable to retrieval (candidates offered vs used in the final derivation DAG). The congruence contest's query-time endpoint is a degenerate first instance. FALSIFIER for the eventual mechanic: a relevance filter that does not reduce wasted budget at equal solve rate on the real substrate is dead weight; one that reduces solve rate has leaked authority into selection and must be rejected regardless of speed.
